Name: Audio Switch Pro
Description: Switch Windows audio devices, control mute and volume, and drive the app that is actually playing — no configuration needed for media.

com.lizard.switchaudio.toggle.Name: Audio Switch
com.lizard.switchaudio.toggle.Tooltip: Select a Windows audio device or cycle through your list; highlight actual default assignment

com.lizard.switchaudio.setvolume.Name: Set Volume
com.lizard.switchaudio.setvolume.Tooltip: Set system volume to specific level

com.lizard.switchaudio.playpause.Name: Play / Pause
com.lizard.switchaudio.playpause.Tooltip: Play or pause whatever is playing right now — works with any app, no setup needed

com.lizard.switchaudio.medianext.Name: Next Track
com.lizard.switchaudio.medianext.Tooltip: Skip to the next track in the app that is playing

com.lizard.switchaudio.mediaprev.Name: Previous Track
com.lizard.switchaudio.mediaprev.Tooltip: Go back to the previous track in the app that is playing

com.lizard.switchaudio.pushtotalk.Name: Push to Talk
com.lizard.switchaudio.pushtotalk.Tooltip: Hold to unmute, release to mute
